findings.quoted_text: Contractor will accommodate reasonable changes to scope requested by Client within the overall project budget.

findings.explanation: Waiting 60 days for payment after invoicing creates a significant cash flow burden for a freelancer.
findings.suggested_change: Change the payment terms to Net 30 or Net 15.

findings.quoted_text: Contractor will accommodate reasonable changes to scope requested by Client within the overall project budget.
findings.explanation: This obligates me to absorb extra tasks or adjustments without additional compensation as long as the total budget is not technically exceeded.
findings.suggested_change: Remove this requirement and specify that any scope changes require a separate written change order with additional fees.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sending over the agreement. I look forward to working together, but would like to propose a couple of adjustments before signing. - In the relevant clause regarding payment, waiting 60 days creates a cash flow burden, so I propose we change the payment terms to Net 30 or Net 15. - In the relevant clause regarding scope, the agreement obligates absorbing extra tasks without additional compensation, so I propose we remove this requirement and specify that any scope changes require a separate written change order with additional fees. Thank you for your time, Best regards
